title: A directed carrier chain frames a whole-form content pivot
summary: Test whether a complete local field with a left directed opener, a whole-form residual pivot, and a right directed closer supports an occurrence-scoped content relation. The 98 BPE units remain formal units; no component is assigned a letter or fixed word meaning.

design.mechanism: joint exterior-role chain plus whole-form residual identity
design.unit: complete hard-chunk or line-bounded field containing a left component role, an exact whole-form residual, and a right component role
design.contrast: a directed opener -> content-pivot -> closer frame versus independent formal edge carriers, a pure boundary field, or a W-capacity artifact
design.prediction: On held complete fields, the joint model predicts a content/operation/opaque-role distinction only when the left and right exterior profiles both agree with their directed roles and the atomic whole residual is retained. Component-only, W-bucket, and within-family whole permutations should lose the joint margin.
design.countermodel: Exterior profiles may be purely positional, and the atomic residual may encode frequency or mobility rather than content. A field can be a title, amount, or diagram label with the same opener/closer shape; W membership is not a word class.
design.falsifier: After freezing complete field boundaries, role labels, whole identity, and matched frequency/mobility controls, the joint chain does not outperform component-only, atomic-only, and permuted-residual rivals on held fields, or its advantage disappears when entry context is held out.
design.principal_risk: GDT607/608 bind formal roles and residual identity but provide no independent English endpoint. Content/operation/opaque labels must remain rival working categories and cannot be promoted to lexical meanings.
design.decision_consequence: A positive result would make a complete directed carrier chain the minimum unit for any later content reading and would prohibit component-by-component word translation. A null would preserve GDT607/608 as formal composition findings while abandoning the content-pivot extension.
design.related: Near GDT608 and GDT611, but distinct: those reports test exterior backoff or lexical-slot/permutation alternatives; this proposal requires a three-position joint chain and tests its held field-level consequence with the W-bucket correction from GDT607.

supporting_sources.claim: W is an output-capacity bucket; five recurring targets have distinct formal carrier roles and no generated plaintext value.

design.smallest_next_step: From already cached guarded artifacts, enumerate complete fields with exact BPE merge boundaries; freeze left/right exterior-role labels, atomic whole identity, entry context, and three rival role annotations; run held joint-versus-component/atomic/permutation comparison and stop if no independently bound field endpoint exists.
